title: UAAP: Late Dasig goal lifts Adamson over UST
summary: A late goal from Marlon Dasig powered Adamson University to a 1-0 win over the University of Santo Tomas in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament, Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
